messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@297362383226142720> it wasn't today's update, it was the farm swap. timeline (UTC, today):
17:07 you sold 8,000 iron mines (they need 0 workers) and bought 8,000 farms
8,000 farms x 50,000 workers each = about 400M extra jobs
17:08-17:09 you swapped some power plants (oil burners/wind farms)
17:10 efficiency shows 31% and the energy deficit hits

you have about 191M workers and your buildings now need about 606M jobs. 191 / 606 = 31%. before the swap you needed roughly 200M, so you were fine. production and power scale with that %.
fix: sell farms or add workers. selling 4,000 farms gets you to about 47%, selling most of them puts you back near 90%+. farms are the job hog here, schools are not the problem.
